title: Canonical Contents alternate-terminology production-owner applicability audit
question: Does the canonical Contents source root contain a standalone file that supplies the complete Q3/A13 production-owner vocabulary under alternate terminology, rather than only merged legacy bundles or partial status prose?
method: Scan only the operator-configured canonical Contents subtrees Docs/math, Github/note, Docs/status and Github/status, with text extensions .txt, .md and .tex; exclude binary and unsupported files.

Apply strict field-boundary aliases for generator/transfer or Markov semigroup, heat-root/heat-kernel or heat-semigroup, filtration/conditional replica or replica, raw-current/current spatial or spatial intertwiner, and q-ledger/ q_k ledger/one-use q/nonnegative q ledger.
Check exact R-192 owner tokens separately, retain path and raw-content SHA-256 counts, and classify merged bundles as false-positive discovery rather than owner evidence.
Run the primary scanner, a non-importing independent reconstruction, an integrated verifier, and hostile mutations that remove groups or attempt merged-bundle, loose-phrase, or promotion acceptance.
finding: The strict alternate-terminology scan covers 1442 paths and 741 unique content hashes, with 701 duplicate paths. It finds zero complete semantic paths, zero standalone owner candidates, and zero exact R-192 owner-token paths. Ten partial paths contain at least three groups. Four loose-q control rows are false positives and none is complete under the strict contract. Primary and independent summaries agree, the integrated verifier passes 12/12 assertions, and the hostile lane rejects 8/8 mutations.
decision_reason: This additive audit tests alternate terminology and explicitly controls merged-bundle and loose-q false positives, answering a different bounded question from the prior exact-token audit. It records a reusable source-applicability boundary while preserving the established T-054 forward method, T-059/T-061 inverse lane, R-192 owner order, and all promotion firewalls.
decision_scope: T0 read-only canonical-Contents source-applicability and terminology-boundary audit; no dynamics, candidate, observation score, physical identification, theorem, or tier transition.
evidence_level: T0 exact read-only canonical-Contents alias scan with path/content-hash deduplication; no model execution
assumptions: The operator-configured Contents root is the maintained canonical source tree for this audit.
The five semantic groups are a bounded alias set for existing R-192 owner slots, not a replacement owner specification.
Replacement text decoding is used only for search and never turns malformed bytes into evidence.
A future standalone source may use terminology outside this alias set and must be evaluated by the unchanged owner contract.
missing_assumptions: A hash-pinned A1 production generator and mobility with heat-root incidence.
A root-labelled filtration and conditional-replica construction.
A raw-current spatial intertwiner and once-owned nonnegative production q-ledger.
A common state, physical projection, boundary, normalization, regulator, volume and limit order.
An admitted Q3 common domain, uniform majorant and downstream OS/KMS/GNS or physical-sector bridge.

adversarial_review.check: A concatenated historical file contains all vocabulary groups but lacks one source edition and field boundary.
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-REJECTED: merged rows are discovery-only and cannot reopen R-192.

adversarial_review.check: Status pages and old notes mention several groups without supplying the complete owner contract.
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-REJECTED: fewer than five groups remain partial/reference material.

adversarial_review.check: A broad one uses ... q phrase could be mistaken for a production q-ledger.
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: only the strict q-ledger alias is admissible; loose-only rows are controls.

adversarial_review.check: The bounded alias set could miss an owner expressed in genuinely different terminology.
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-OPEN: this result is not a global source-absence theorem.

adversarial_review.check: Docs and Github mirrors could be counted as independent sources.
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: path and raw SHA-256 unique counts are reported separately.

adversarial_review.check: Could the audit replace T-054, T-059, T-061 or the R-192 owner order?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: this is additive provenance intake; methods and order are unchanged.

adversarial_review.check: Could vocabulary co-occurrence be promoted to QFT, physical, continuum or mass-gap evidence?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-REJECTED: claim_bearing remains false and all promotion flags remain closed.

boundary: R-459 is a bounded read-only source-applicability audit. It does not prove universal source absence, supply a production owner, admit a candidate, define an observation map, evaluate a physical-empty branch, close a limit, identify QFT/Yang--Mills/gravity, or establish Pre-A, Sector-A, C6 or a mass gap.
next_action: Keep the forward owner branch parked under the existing R-192 fingerprint. Reopen only if a new standalone, hash-pinned source supplies the complete owner fields; in parallel continue the unchanged T-059/T-061 observation-source lock and current P1 work packet.
stop_or_redesign: If the configured Contents root changes, issue a new audit with new root provenance rather than mutating this record.
If a standalone all-five file appears, stop this audit at its zero-boundary and start the unchanged R-192 owner order from that source.
If terminology expansion is proposed, version the alias set and retain this result as the prior bounded audit.
Do not create another finite mobility, physical-empty, or geometry table in response to this source boundary.
non_claims: No universal absence of a QFT or A13 production owner is proved.
No future or unindexed source is refuted.

No generator, heat semigroup, filtration, raw-current map, q-ledger, candidate, observation map, score, physical identity, continuum, Yang--Mills, Pre-A, Sector-A, cosmic-origin, theory-of-everything, or mass-gap statement follows.
The established T-054 forward method, T-059/T-061 inverse methods, owner order, and promotion firewalls are unchanged.
